verdict.rationale: Warp's Automation Platform explicitly supports cloud agents that run autonomously in the background, triggered by schedules, webhooks, or integrations like Slack/GitHub/Linear (warp-docs-4, warp-docs-5, warp-docs-60), with observability/audit trails (warp-docs-53, warp-docs-61) and CLI/API control via Oz CLI for headless/CI use (warp-docs-22, warp-docs-37, warp-docs-63). missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of autonomous background runs actually completing unattended, and more detail on failure handling/reliability at scale.
